description: BITB-025 — canonical Traditional->Simplified single-character map for Bible book names. The three platform implementations (api/utils/chinese_script.py, frontend/src/lib/chineseScript.ts, and the Android equivalent once BITB-025's Android fast-follow lands) must all equal this table exactly, verified by a parity test on each platform. Derived by Simplified->Traditional converting every Chinese book name/alias in api/utils/translation_registry.py with an authoritative converter (dev-time only, not a runtime dependency) and collecting the resulting character-level diffs.
